steps.name: array_fault_current
steps.formula: I = min(plant earth fault, max(1.5 x I_ac_max, I_dc_sc)) of the largest inverter

inputs.name: I_ac_max
inputs.source: catalog: maximum AC apparent power 110 kVA at 400 V

inputs.name: factor
inputs.source: IEA PVPS T5-01:1998 'Utility aspects of grid connected photovoltaic power systems': the short-circuit current of a PV inverter system is restricted to 1.1 to 1.5 times its rated current (upper end used)

steps.source: IEA PVPS T5-01:1998 'Utility aspects of grid connected photovoltaic power systems': the short-circuit current of a PV inverter system is restricted to 1.1 to 1.5 times its rated current (upper end used)

steps.name: electrode_current
steps.formula: I = 7.57 x 1000 / sqrt(rho t) x pi d L
steps.source: IS 3043 maximum current density at the electrode surface J = 7.57 x 1000 / sqrt(rho t) A/m2, as quoted in J. Parmar, part 1, electrical-engineering-portal.com

steps.name: strip_current
steps.formula: I = 7.57 x 1000 / sqrt(rho t) x 2 (w + t) L, summed over the conductor sizes
steps.source: IS 3043 maximum current density at the electrode surface J = 7.57 x 1000 / sqrt(rho t) A/m2, as quoted in J. Parmar, part 1, electrical-engineering-portal.com
assumptions: the surface current density limit is applied to the buried flat conductor as an electrode as well as to the pits

steps.name: pipe_resistance
steps.formula: R = 100 rho / (2 pi L) ln(4 L / d), L and d in cm
steps.source: IS 3043 pipe or rod electrode R = 100 rho / (2 pi L) ln(4 L / d), L and d in cm, as quoted in J. Parmar, part 1, electrical-engineering-portal.com

steps.name: strip_resistance
steps.formula: R = 100 rho / (2 pi L) ln(2 L^2 / (w t)), L, w, t in cm
steps.source: IS 3043 buried strip R = 100 rho / (2 pi L) ln(2 L^2 / (w t)), L, w, t in cm, as quoted in J. Parmar, part 2, electrical-engineering-portal.com

assumptions: earth electrode 40 mm dia x 3 m long (as on the CIL/Refex earthing layout unless set)
pits spaced at least two electrode lengths apart are combined as parallel resistances, in parallel with the buried conductor
conductor sized to the larger of the IS 3043 (k = 80) and IEEE 80 (Kf = 28.96) cross-sections
no corrosion allowance on the conductor cross-section (set corrosion_allowance to add one)

table-row (MMS) conductors 25x6 GS flat: the larger of the thermal size for the inverter fault contribution 400 A and the 25x6 rail earthing of the CIL/Refex reference layouts, never above the main conductor; main ring, station and switchyard conductors keep the plant fault size 25x6
25x3 GS flat down conductors (practice; confirm against IS/IEC 62305-3 and NF C 17-102 minimum sections)

target earth resistance 2 ohm (commercial premises 2 ohm; earth resistance practice table in J. Parmar, 'How to determine correct number of earthing electrodes, part 2', electrical-engineering-portal.com); not a cited limit, set target_resistance_ohm to override
IS 3043 surface current density applied to the whole electrode surface in soil: the pits and the buried flat conductor
earth resistance: Sverak (IEEE 80) resistance of the buried network over its convex hull area, which is above the pits-and-strip value and governs
